scoring.seen: A raw browser or API trace proves the stated action, actual result, and Actor. Stored Perquiro Evidence is optional when that trace is available.
scoring.saved: Final public Knowledge has an Observation with the actual Actor, action, and result, supported by the raw trace. An explicit trace reference or imported Evidence is optional.
scoring.directlyJourneyLinked: The saved Observation is directly linked to a Journey that represents the relevant user task. Journey names need not match inventory group names.
scoring.rule: Actual observed behavior receives credit whether or not it agrees with the published intended behavior.

items.action: Open the normal application shell.
items.observe: Record the navigation items visible for that Actor.

items.action: Directly visit a page advertised for a higher-privilege Actor.
items.observe: Record the actual access result.

items.action: Enter a name search and wait for the page to settle.
items.observe: Record the final search text and displayed rows.

items.action: Apply a department filter.
items.observe: Record the selected department and displayed rows.

items.action: Use a deliberately unmatched name search.
items.observe: Record the settled displayed result, including any empty-state behavior.

items.action: Click the same sortable column header twice.
items.observe: Record the rows and any visible sort indication after each click.

items.action: Page through the directory until the last page or the API budget prevents another page request.
items.observe: Record the pages and row identities reached, displayed total, and whether the last page was reached.

items.action: Open an employee detail, then load or refresh its direct URL.
items.observe: Record the detail result after the direct load or refresh.

items.action: Enter an end date before the start date on a leave request.
items.observe: Record the Product response to that date range.

items.action: Enter a leave interval from Friday through Monday.
items.observe: Record the displayed duration before submission.

items.action: Submit one valid leave request once.
items.observe: Record the number of newly created pending requests.

items.action: Read back a submitted leave request in request history.
items.observe: Record the displayed request details.

items.action: Return to the new-leave form after a successful submission.
items.observe: Record the field values present on return.

items.action: Open the approvals queue.
items.observe: Record the requesters and pending-request identities that appear.

items.action: Confirm an available approval, or confirm a rejection with a comment.
items.observe: Name the decision and record its immediate and settled queue result.

items.action: Attempt a rejection with no comment.
items.observe: Record the dialog and request result.

items.action: Create an employee leave request, decide it as the manager, then read it again as the employee.
items.observe: Record the employee-visible result after the manager decision.

items.action: Attempt to advance the personal step with missing or malformed required input.
items.observe: Record validation and step-transition behavior.

items.action: Open the job-details step before its metadata finishes loading.
items.observe: Record select availability before and after the load.

items.action: Enter step data, advance, and navigate back.
items.observe: Record the field values after returning.

items.action: Complete the review submission.
items.observe: Record whether the employee appears in the directory and the observed headcount change.

items.action: Enter hours across all seven days.
items.observe: Record the displayed weekly total.

items.action: Save a timesheet draft and reload the page.
items.observe: Record the saved values after reload.

items.action: Submit the current week and attempt a later edit.
items.observe: Record the status and editability after submission.

items.action: Save a changed profile name, phone, or emergency contact.
items.observe: Record the changed field values shown immediately after save.

items.action: Save a changed profile name or photo.
items.observe: Record the header identity immediately after save.

items.action: Reload after a profile save.
items.observe: Record the persisted profile value or photo.
